name: @footon/fuel
description: Nutrition tools, USDA FoodData Central integration, and food logging storage for Footon

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && printf '{"type":"commonjs"}\n' > dist/types/package.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
